facts.fact: CIPESA says Guinea blocked access to Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram and TikTok in May 2023 ahead of nationwide demonstrations.
CIPESA says Mauritania restricted mobile internet for 22 days from 2 July 2024 after the 29 June presidential election and protests disputing the result.
CIPESA says Mauritania cut mobile internet for nearly a week during protests in May and June 2023.
CIPESA says mobile data was blocked nationwide in Senegal in early February 2024 after the presidential election was postponed, the country's third disruption in under 12 months.
CIPESA reports that the ECOWAS Court of Justice ruled on 14 May 2025 that Senegal's internet and social media shutdowns of June and July 2023 violated fundamental rights.
facts.system: ECOWAS Court judgment, ASUTIC and Ndiaga Gueye v. Senegal

TGO.note: Mentions only the 2020 ECOWAS ruling that ordered Togo to pay a fine over protest-time shutdowns; no dated cut is stated.
